summary.en: Friday pre-market shows mixed sentiment as investors weigh year-end positioning and upcoming earnings announcements. Geopolitical developments in the Middle East continue to support oil prices while Fed policy expectations remain data-dependent.
summary.zh: 周五盘前情绪分化，投资者权衡年末配置和即将发布的财报。中东地缘政治发展继续支撑油价，美联储政策预期仍取决于数据。

title.en: Tech Earnings Season Accelerates with AI Chip Leaders Delivering Above Expectations
title.zh: 科技财报季加速，AI 芯片龙头表现超出预期

impact.en: Strong demand for advanced AI chips validates capex strategy across hyperscalers. Sector leadership positions reinforced while traditional semiconductor exposure lags.
impact.zh: 先进 AI 芯片强劲需求验证超大规模数据中心资本支出策略。板块领导地位巩固而传统半导体敞口滞后。

macroRisk.en: No - Earnings-driven rally independent of macro environment.
macroRisk.zh: 否 - 财报驱动的上涨独立于宏观环境。

title.en: Oil Prices Benefit from Middle East Tensions Despite OPEC+ Discipline
title.zh: 油价从中东紧张局势受益尽管 OPEC+ 保持纪律

impact.en: Geopolitical risk premium sustains WTI near key resistance levels. Supply disruption concerns limit downside but cap upside given global recession fears.
impact.zh: 地缘政治风险溢价使 WTI 维持在关键阻力位附近。供应中断担忧限制下行但全球衰退恐惧抑制上行空间。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Oil volatility transmits to inflation expectations with implications for Fed policy stance.
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 油价波动传导至通胀预期并对美联储政策立场产生影响。

title.en: Treasury Yields Stabilize as Year-End Positioning Normalizes Market Dynamics
title.zh: 美债收益率稳定，年末配置正常化市场动态

impact.en: 10Y yield consolidation reflects balanced positioning between inflation concerns and dovish policy expectations. Rate-sensitive sectors find support.
impact.zh: 10 年期收益率盘整反映通胀担忧和鸽派政策预期之间的平衡配置。利率敏感板块获得支撑。

macroRisk.en: Medium - Yield direction sensitive to economic data releases and Fed commentary.
macroRisk.zh: 中等 - 收益率方向对经济数据发布和美联储评论敏感。

title.en: Dollar Index Modulates on Mixed Economic Signals from Global Partners
title.zh: 美元指数在对全球伙伴的混合经济信号中调整

impact.en: DXY consolidates as safe-haven flows balance with EM asset outflows. Multinational earnings visibility improves but currency headwinds persist.
impact.zh: DXY 盘整避险资金流与新兴资产流出相互制衡。跨国企业收益能见度改善但货币逆风持续。

macroRisk.en: Yes - DXY strength impacts growth prospects for FX-sensitive sectors.
macroRisk.zh: 是 - DXY 强度影响外汇敏感板块增长前景。

title.en: Gold Maintains Support Levels Amid Uncertain Macro Environment
title.zh: 黄金在不确定宏观环境下维持支撑位

impact.en: Precious metals hold technical levels despite dollar strength. Central bank purchases and geopolitical uncertainty provide demand floor.
impact.zh: 贵金属尽管美元强劲维持技术水平。央行购买和地缘政治不确定性提供需求底部。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Gold-pricing mechanism links dollar strength inversely to precious metal prices.
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 黄金定价机制将美元强度与贵金属价格反向关联。

ai.en: Leadership remains robust with hyperscaler AI infrastructure investments supporting demand pipeline. Cloud providers' data center build-out reinforces semiconductor exposure chain.
ai.zh: 领导地位保持强劲，超大规模数据中心 AI 基础设施投资支持需求管道。云提供商的数据中心建设加强半导体敞口链。

semiconductor.en: Advanced node leaders outperform on chip demand fundamentals. Legacy node exposure faces inventory headwinds but normalization progressing at moderate pace.
semiconductor.zh: 先进节点领导者在芯片需求基本面方面表现优异。传统节点敞口面临库存逆风但正常化以中等节奏推进。

bigTech.en: Resilient earnings profiles supported by AI monetization progress and cloud margin expansion. Consumer spending concerns offset but quality factor premium intact.
bigTech.zh: AI 变现进展和云计算利润率扩张支持强劲收益表现。消费者支出担忧抵消但质量因子溢价保持完整。

energy.en: Trading higher on geopolitical risk premium with OPEC+ production discipline providing floor. Supply constraint concerns balanced against recession risks limit upside.
energy.zh: 地缘政治风险溢价推动上涨，OPEC+ 生产纪律提供底部。供应约束担忧与衰退风险平衡限制上行空间。

ev.en: Valuation pressure persists as consumer preference shifts toward traditional ICE vehicles. China production challenges impact global EV supply chain outlook negatively.
ev.zh: 估值压力持续，消费者偏好转向传统内燃机车辆。中国生产挑战对全球 EV 供应链前景产生负面影响。

market.en: Broad market cautious ahead of earnings season close. Year-end positioning drives sector rotation while AI leaders provide growth anchor amid macro uncertainty.
market.zh: 大盘谨慎等待财报季结束。年末配置推动板块轮动而 AI 领导者在不确定的宏观环境中提供增长锚点。

preciousMetals.en: Gold and silver maintain technical support levels. Safe-haven demand balances with dollar strength creating range-bound trading dynamics with upside potential if geopolitical tensions escalate.
preciousMetals.zh: 黄金和白银维持关键技术支撑水平。避险需求与美元强度平衡创造区间交易动态，地缘政治紧张升级时具备上行潜力。

oil.en: WTI consolidating near recent highs with geopolitical risk premium supporting levels. Supply disruption concerns from Middle East tensions balanced against recession fears capping upside.
oil.zh: WTI 在最近高点附近盘整，地缘政治风险溢价支撑水平。中东紧张局势的供应中断担忧与衰退恐惧平衡限制上行空间。

futures.en: S&P futures neutral to slightly higher, Nasdaq mixed on tech divergence, Dow under pressure from industrials. Year-end positioning drives cautious sentiment.
futures.zh: 标普期货中性至微幅上涨，纳指因科技股分化混杂，道指受制于工业股承压。年末配置推动谨慎情绪。

treasury10Y.en: 10Y Treasury yield stabilizing around recent levels with year-end positioning normalizing market dynamics. Expectations for Fed policy remain data-dependent.
treasury10Y.zh: 10 年期美债收益率在最近水平附近稳定，年末配置正常化市场动态。对美联储政策的预期仍取决于数据。

dxy.en: Dollar Index consolidating as safe-haven flows balance with EM asset outflows. Cross-asset positioning adjusts on mixed global economic signals.
dxy.zh: 美元指数盘整避险资金流与新兴资产流出相互平衡。跨资产配置在对全球混合经济信号的调整下适应。

oil.en: WTI crude trading near key resistance with geopolitical risk premium supporting levels. Supply concerns from Middle East tensions limit downside potential.
oil.zh: WTI 原油在关键阻力附近交易，地缘政治风险溢价支撑水平。中东紧张的供应担忧限制下行潜力。

keyRisk.en: Economic data releases this week including earnings surprises and inflation readings could trigger volatility. Monitor Fed speakers for policy direction signals amid year-end positioning uncertainty.
keyRisk.zh: 本周经济数据发布包括财报意外和通胀读数可能引发波动。在年末配置不确定性中监测美联储演讲者获取政策方向信号。

note.en: Market sentiment divided with AI leaders resilient while rate-sensitive and emerging market sectors face headwinds. Geopolitical developments dominate oil and precious metals pricing. Year-end positioning adds uncertainty to breadth.
note.zh: 市场情绪分化，AI 领导者表现稳健而利率敏感和新兴市场板块面临逆风。地缘政治发展主导油价和贵金属定价。年末配置为广度增加不确定性。
